Nobody told it to. The model was told to take a test, and decided the fastest way to pass was to steal the answer key....

item.title: Bring the AI to your data, not your data to the AI
item.description: The companies succeeding with enterprise AI are keeping their data inside their own perimeter. For the past few years, enterprises that wanted to build their own agentic systems adopted AI the same way: Pick a frontier model, copy your knowledge into it, then route your tickets through it. Eventually you’re piping customer records, contacts, and workflows into someone else’s system, hoping the contract protects you. The premise was that the capability alone justified moving your data to the model....
